title: LLM-Powered Predictive Decision-Making for Sustainable Data Center Operations
abstract: arXiv:2608.18503v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing demand for AI-driven workloads, particularly from Large Language Models (LLMs), has raised concerns about the significant energy and resource consumption in data centers. This work introduces a novel LLM-based predictive scheduling system designed to enhance operational efficiency while reducing the environmental impact of data centers. Our system utilizes an LLM to predict key metrics such as execution time and energy consumption from source code, and it has the potential to extend to other sustainability-focused metrics like water usage for cooling and carbon emissions, provided the data center can track such data. The predictive model is followed by a real-time scheduling algorithm that allocates GPU resources, aiming to improve sustainability by optimizing both energy consumption and queuing delays. With fast inference times, the ability to generalize across diverse task types, and minimal data requirements for training,

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的可持续数据中心运营预测性决策
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18503v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着对AI驱动工作负载需求的增长，尤其是来自大型语言模型（LLMs）的工作负载，数据中心在能源和资源消耗方面的显著问题引起了关注。本研究提出了一种新颖的基于LLM的预测性调度系统，旨在提高运营效率的同时减少数据中心的环境影响。我们的系统利用LLM从源代码预测关键指标，如执行时间和能耗，并且有可能扩展到其他可持续性相关指标，如冷却用水量和碳排放量，前提是数据中心能够跟踪此类数据。该预测模型之后是一个实时调度算法，用于分配GPU资源，旨在通过优化能耗和排队延迟来提高可持续性。凭借快速推理时间、跨多种任务类型的泛化能力以及训练所需的最少数据量，该系统展现了显著优势。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的预测性调度系统，通过从源代码预测执行时间和能耗并实时优化GPU资源分配，以提高数据中心运营效率并减少环境影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-based predictive scheduling system that predicts execution time and energy consumption from source code and optimizes GPU allocation in real time to enhance data center operational efficiency and reduce environmental impact.
